recognize_zh: 這張圖並非形態影像，而且只呈現 A 格的正常紅血球體積直方圖示意（單一對稱峰、MCV 與 RDW 標示、60/120 fL 虛線），標題所說的「隨時間變化」序列（B 格）不在此圖中。
features: Schematic normal RBC volume histogram (panel A only) with frequency versus cell volume in fL
Single symmetric unimodal peak near 90 fL indicating the MCV
Double-headed arrow across the curve denoting the RDW
Solid lines bounding the central 92% of the red cell population
Dashed lines at 60 fL and 120 fL defining microcytic and macrocytic fractions
describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic schematic showing only panel A, a normal impedance red cell volume histogram, although the title refers to serial histograms over time. The curve is a single symmetric population centered around 90 fL, with the MCV marked at the peak and the RDW as the distribution width. Solid lines mark the central 92% of cells, and dashed lines at 60 and 120 fL quantify microcytic and macrocytic fractions. In TTP, comparison with this reference would reveal a microcytic tail from schistocytes early and a macrocytic reticulocyte shoulder during recovery, but those serial curves are not included in this image.
